questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count carbons in the aldol product
questions.stem: From the numbers, two molecules of acetaldehyde combine in an aldol addition. How many carbons does the beta-hydroxy aldehyde product contain?
questions.explanation: Each acetaldehyde contributes two carbons, so the aldol addition product, 3-hydroxybutanal, contains four carbons with no atoms lost during addition.

provenance.author: orgchem2-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count ester groups in the product
questions.stem: From the numbers, a Claisen condensation of two esters gives a beta-keto ester. How many ester carbonyl groups remain in the product?
questions.explanation: Of the two ester groups consumed, one becomes a ketone and one remains as an ester, so the beta-keto ester product contains a single ester carbonyl.
questions.hint: One ester becomes a ketone, one remains.

provenance.author: orgchem2-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count alpha hydrogens
questions.stem: From the numbers, how many alpha hydrogens are present on acetone?
questions.explanation: Acetone has two methyl groups adjacent to the carbonyl, each bearing three hydrogens, so there are six alpha hydrogens in total that can be removed to form an enolate.

provenance.author: orgchem2-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count atoms in the newly formed ring of Robinson annulation
questions.stem: From the numbers, a Robinson annulation typically constructs a six-membered ring. How many atoms are in that ring?
questions.explanation: The intramolecular aldol ring closure of a Robinson annulation produces a six-membered cyclohexenone ring, a common motif in fused ring synthesis.

provenance.author: orgchem2-bank-author
provenance.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count atoms moved in tautomerization
questions.stem: From the numbers, in keto-enol tautomerization, how many protons are transferred between oxygen and the alpha carbon?
questions.explanation: Tautomerization moves a single proton from the alpha carbon to the carbonyl oxygen while the double bond shifts, so one proton is relocated between the two sites.

questions.subject: ORGANIC_CHEMISTRY_II
questions.learningObjective: Count carboxyl groups in the intermediate
questions.stem: From the numbers, diethyl malonate contains how many ester carbonyl groups before alkylation?
questions.explanation: Diethyl malonate is a diester with two ester carbonyl groups flanking a central methylene, which is why it can be deprotonated and alkylated at that central carbon.
questions.hint: It is a diester with two carbonyls.
